what: the AlphaFold model of human DNA dC->dU-editing enzyme APOBEC-3D (APOBEC3D), one chain, cut between its two domains

source.cite: Jumper et al., Nature 596, 583 (2021); Varadi et al., Nucleic Acids Res. 52, D368 (2024)
source.file_is: the database's files, packed (gzip, no time stamp)

participants_from: the first and the last residue of the two domains that TED (The Encyclopedia of Domains, CC BY 4.0) assigns to this entry
why_this_case: Two confident domains whose arrangement the model does not know: every contact has a high predicted aligned error.
